# DRI PIP behavioral reference

Exact source from the commit recorded in provenance.json, retained with its
original bytes and copyright. LICENSE reproduces the upstream distribution
permission text. This is a reference for the BetterCP/M Z80/ZSM4 port; no PL/M
compiler is added to the production build. The source identifies PIP version
1.5 and checks for CP/M 2.0 or newer. Source identity alone does not establish
a particular stock CP/M 2.2 binary: the matching binary/manual remain to be
pinned and tested. Do not call a newly compiled reference binary an original.

The reference PIP.COM was extracted from the unchanged tracked z80pack CP/M
2.2 distribution disk recorded in provenance.json. Its embedded PIP 1.5
identity and patch-page layout match the source description. It is retained
for behavioral comparison, not shipped as BetterCP/M PIP.
